I want to build a KernelSU module. Put the whole draft inside one make_module action (plan mode is on for this request): id, name, version, versionCode, author, description, the files array (each item {path, content}), and install_script when the installation needs extra steps. The id must match ^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$ (starts with a letter, at least 2 characters). The client renders the draft as a plan card I can approve in one tap and pre-fills the module maker page with it; installation only runs after I confirm the red dialog.
How many model turns one message may chain
One round is one model reply plus the actions it asks for, executed locally. More rounds let the assistant finish multi-step work; every round costs one more API call.
Characters one file read returns to the model
Every read stops at this many characters and tells the model which start_line to continue from. Larger values cost more tokens per call.
Files up to this size are read in one piece
A file no larger than this is returned complete. Larger files come back as one window, and the assistant must continue with start_line or locate content with search_in_file.
